prova:
{
    intro hF
    obtain ⟨M, hm⟩ := Set.Finite.exists_bound hF
    set S : ℕ → Set ℕ := fun n => {m : ℕ | u m < u (m + 1) ∧ u (m + 1) < u (m + 2)} with hS
    set T := ∪ n > M, S n with hT
    have hTmem : T ∈ Filter.atTop := hT
    have hTsub : T ⊆ {n : ℕ | u n < u (n + 1) ∧ u (n + 1) < u (n + 2)} := by
      intro n hn
      rcases hn with ⟨n0, ⟨hn0, ⟨h1, h2⟩⟩⟩
      exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have hmem : {n : ℕ | u n < u (n + 1) ∧ u (n + 1) < u (n + 2)} ∈ Filter.atTop :=
      Filter.eventually_mono hTmem hTsub
    have habsurd : False := by
      rcases hmem with ⟨N, hN⟩
      set n := max M N with hn
      have hnc : n ≥ M := by
        rw [hn]
        exact le_max_left M N
      have hNc : n ≥ N := by
        rw [hn]
        exact le_max_right M N
      have hnotin : n ∉ {n : ℕ | u n < u (n + 1) ∧ u (n + 1) < u (n + 2)} := by
        intro h
        rcases h with ⟨h1, h2⟩
        exact hm n ⟨h1, h2⟩ hnc
      exact hNc |> hN n hnotin
    exact habsurd
  }
